desc:
🎤 Welcome to KITE — KPOP Idol Trading Experience!

💸 YOUR IDOL CARDS EARN CASH EVEN WHILE YOU'RE AWAY!

How to Play:
📦 Open album boxes and collect K-pop idol cards!
🏠 Place cards at your base to generate cash!
✨ Hunt for rare cards and powerful mutations!
🔄 Rebirth to unlock more tiles and new floors!
🤝 Trade with other players and complete your index!
💎 Chase limited-time packs and exclusive cards!

⭐ Can you build the ultimate K-pop card collection?

📱 Play on PC, Mobile & Tablet!
